_comment: Ice Sculpture collection: Pokémon carved from ice. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed ice-sculpture-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Ice Sculptures
readme.summary: Pokemon carved out of a block of ice.
looks: clear glacier-ice blues mapped from the Pokemon's own light and shade, so every marking is chiselled in
faceted chisel planes, refracting light streaks, hairline cracks, trapped air bubbles and a frosted rim
glints that twinkle and glow in the dark; glowing parts turn to an icy cyan glow
shiny: Aurora Ice, shimmering teal to violet
